title: axios helper: parseHeaders

spec.text: Parse the raw response header block (one 'Name: value' per line) into an object keyed by lower-cased header name, matching Node's message.headers rules: for the listed singleton headers keep the first occurrence and discard later duplicates, always collect set-cookie into an array, and join other duplicates with ', '.

context: Used by the XHR adapter on xhr.getAllResponseHeaders(). utils.toObjectSet(arr) returns a plain object literal mapping each string to true. Header values may legitimately be empty strings (e.g. 'Content-Length:' or 'X-Foo:'). The result is later wrapped in AxiosHeaders and returned to user code as response.headers.

source.notes: Whole lib/helpers/parseHeaders.js at parent commit 4106dda; key from fix commit 78b5187 'fix: preserve empty duplicate header values (#11036)', which replaced truthiness checks with own-property checks.
